# Quran text — Tanzil Project

`data/quran-uthmani.txt` is the **Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani, Version 1.1)**, downloaded verbatim
from <https://tanzil.net/download/> on 2026-11-17 with these options:

- Quran type: Uthmani
- Output: text with aya numbers (`sura|aya|text`, one ayah per line, 6,236 lines)
- Pause marks: yes · Sajdah signs: yes · Rub-el-hizb signs: no · Tatweel below superscript alefs: yes

**Do not edit this file.** The licence allows verbatim copies only. Our scripts normalise a _copy in
memory_ (see `scripts/lib/quran.ts`); the file on disk stays untouched. To update, download again with
the same options and replace the whole file.

The file is a build-time asset (used by `npm run validate` and the content scripts). It is not shipped
to the browser.
